origine_fr: Pour s'en souvenir : 舟, la barque, et 叟, le vieillard, qui donne le son (sǒu / sōu). On compte les bateaux comme un vieux batelier. On dit 一艘船, un bateau.
origine_en: To remember it: 舟, the boat, and 叟, the old man, which gives the sound (sǒu / sōu). Boats are counted as an old boatman would. You say 一艘船, one boat.

phrase.pinyin: Hǎi shang yǒu yī sōu chuán.
phrase.fr: Il y a un bateau sur la mer.
phrase.en: There is a ship on the sea.
